mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, payment_time = CASE WHEN #{paymentStatus} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE payment_time END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND order_status = 1 AND payment_status = 0 AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE)

SELECT o.id FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN product_reviews pr ON pr.order_id = o.id AND pr.product_id = oi.product_id AND pr.user_id = o.user_id AND pr.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.user_id = #{userId} AND oi.product_id = #{productId} AND o.order_status = 4 AND o.payment_status = 1 AND pr.id IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(o.received_time, o.updated_at, o.created_at) DESC LIMIT 1
